summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 7a Google OAuth authentication and multi-tenant workspace scoping tests. All core authentication and workspace isolation features are working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: User2 workspace has 0 integrations instead of expected 5 providers
minor_issues.impact: New workspaces may not have integrations catalog seeded

passed_tests: Unauthenticated access returns 401 for all protected endpoints
Session exchange validates session_id correctly (401 for invalid)
/api/auth/me returns user profile with workspaces array and is_current flags
Workspace isolation: User1 (default) and User2 (ws_test_92c73371) see completely disjoint data
Contacts isolation: User1=7 contacts, User2=1 contact, no overlap
Inbox isolation: User1=6 items, User2=0 items, no overlap
Calendar isolation: User1=11 events, User2=0 events, no overlap
Simulation mode isolation: User1=true, User2=false, independent per workspace
Write tagging: New contacts tagged with correct workspace_id and is_simulation
Cross-workspace write isolation: User1 cannot see User2's new contacts
Workspace management: Create new workspace, switch workspaces, membership validation
X-Workspace-Id header support for explicit workspace scoping
Integration scoping: User1 has 5 integrations, User2 isolated (0 integrations)
Dashboard metrics include workspace-specific simulation_mode field
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor: Ensure new workspaces get integrations catalog seeded with all 5 providers (gmail, google_calendar, crm, openai, webhook). Currently User2's workspace has 0 integrations.
